integrity: All proofs and source comparisons are self-review, with no independent audit or claim of independently established historical priority. The numerical and enumerative checks support, but do not replace, the infinite-parameter arguments.
scientific_limitations: The class consists only of products of pairwise disjoint adjacent transpositions. The two-type Poisson limit assumes \(q_n\to0\) and finite \(nq_n^2\); no assertion is made about general involutions, arbitrary positive fixed q, or a quantified optimal convergence rate.
title: Two Poisson obstruction fields at the sparse-Mallows adjacent-matching threshold
